name: orchestrator-playbook
description: Multi-agent orchestration: one orchestrator plans, splits task cards, dispatches workers in parallel git worktrees, reviews every branch and is the only one who merges.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, dispatch, review and merge across multiple coding agents
interface.longDescription: Use when you are appointed orchestrator: split work into self-contained task cards, dispatch them to worker agents in parallel git worktrees, review every branch yourself, and merge as the only integrator.
defaultPrompt: Act as the orchestrator for this repo: read the control plane and tell me what is next.
Split this milestone into task cards and dispatch the first wave.
